name: Jonathan Polach Photography
description: Wedding and event photographer. Natural, unhurried photographs of the people and moments that matter.

contact.intro: Tell me a little about your plans and I will reply within a couple of days.

home.intro: I photograph weddings and celebrations the way they actually feel: unhurried, warm, and a little bit wild. No stiff poses, just the people you love and the moments you'll want back.

process.title: Say hello
process.text: Tell me your date and what you have in mind. I'll reply within a couple of days.

process.title: Plan together
process.text: We'll talk through the day, the light, and the people who matter most to you.

process.title: Relax and enjoy
process.text: I stay close and out of the way. Your full gallery arrives within four weeks.

testimonials.quote: We forgot he was even there, and somehow he caught every single moment we'd have missed.
testimonials.name: Sample client, edit me
